reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 2 points better, in a game of about 227 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 56 times in 100, by about 2; most games like this end between 203 and 251 total points.

analyst.text: Detroit lost to Toronto on the second night of a back-to-back and are missing Jalen Duren, Duncan Robinson and Ron Holland, though Cade Cunningham is back from knee soreness. J.B. Bickerstaff says he won't rush the injured players. Atlanta have won three straight but lost CJ McCollum for at least four weeks, and rookie Kingston Flemings has back tightness. The angle leans slightly towards Atlanta at home.
